subtitle: In the coconut groves of Kerala, reasoning finds its own tongue

panels.action: Jyeshthadeva sits beneath tall coconut palms near Tirur, palm-leaf manuscript and stylus in hand, distant temple roofs and backwaters behind him, as if the land itself listens to his quiet resolve.

dialogue.text: In sixteenth‑century Kerala, Jyeshthadeva begins Yuktibhāṣā, casting deep astronomical proofs into living Malayalam words.

i18n.hi: सोलहवीं सदी के केरल में ज्येष्ठदेव युक्तिभाषा शुरू करते हैं, गहरे खगोलीय सिद्धांतों को जीवित मलयालम शब्दों में ढालते हुए.

panels.shot: wide establishing shot from slightly elevated angle
panels.action: The Parangngottu family area near Trikkandiyur and Tirur spreads under a hazy sky—temple spires, tiled Brahmin houses, a small path to the river—while young Jyeshthadeva walks, clutching a bundle of palm leaves.

dialogue.text: On the Malabar coast, between Trikkandiyur and Tirur, the Parangngottu Brahmin families live amidst temples, backwaters and learning.

i18n.hi: मलबार तट पर, त्रिक्कंदियूर और तिरूर के बीच, परंग्गोट्टू ब्राह्मण परिवार मंदिरों, बैकवॉटर और विद्या के बीच बसते हैं.

panels.action: Inside a modest but scholarly household, Jyeshthadeva sits cross‑legged by an oil lamp, carefully tracing Sanskrit aksharas on a palm leaf, his brows knit as he recites a compact astronomical verse.

dialogue.text: He learns in the traditional way—dense Sanskrit sūtras, verses that carry numbers, orbits and shadows within a few breathless lines.

i18n.hi: वह परंपरागत ढंग से सीखता है—घने संस्कृत सूत्र, श्लोक जिनमें चंद पंक्तियों में ही अंक, कक्षाएँ और साए छिपे हैं.

panels.shot: close-up on face, stylus poised mid‑air
panels.action: Jyeshthadeva pauses mid‑writing, stylus hovering, eyes half‑closed as if a question troubles him, rows of palm leaves marked with formulas lying beside him.

dialogue.text: Verses state results, not always reasons. In the silence, the young student feels a gap between rule and understanding.

i18n.hi: श्लोक फल बताते हैं, वजह नहीं। उस ख़ामोशी में नवयुवक को नियम और समझ के बीच खाली जगह महसूस होती है.

panels.shot: medium shot in small classroom, students around
panels.action: Under a sloping tiled roof, an older Jyeshthadeva now teaches, drawing geometric figures on the packed earth while a circle of students lean forward, some puzzled, some eager.

dialogue.text: Years pass. Jyeshthadeva becomes a teacher in the Kerala tradition of astronomy and Ganita, entrusted with guiding minds through subtle calculations.

i18n.hi: बरस बीतते हैं। ज्येष्ठदेव केरल की ज्योतिष और गणित परंपरा में आचार्य बनते हैं, मनों को सूक्ष्म गणनाओं से गुज़ारने का भार सँभालते हैं.

panels.shot: medium shot, over Jyeshthadeva’s shoulder toward confused students
panels.action: We see Jyeshthadeva from behind as he recites a Sanskrit verse on planetary computation; in front, a young student frowns, fingers unconsciously tracing dust patterns, struggling to follow.

dialogue.speaker: jyeshthadeva
dialogue.text: You know the rule, but do you see why it must be so?

i18n.hi: नियम तो याद है, पर दिखता है कि ऐसा होना क्यों ज़रूरी है?

panels.shot: extreme close-up on Jyeshthadeva’s thoughtful eyes
panels.action: His eyes reflect lamplight and faint diagrams scratched on the floor; his expression is firm yet compassionate, sensing both the beauty and the barrier of the Sanskrit verses.

dialogue.text: He realizes that many students can chant the verses, yet the path from step to step hides in his own unspoken reasoning.

i18n.hi: उसे दिखता है कि कई छात्र श्लोक तो गा लेते हैं, पर हर कदम का रास्ता उसके अपने अनकहे तर्क में छुपा रहता है.

panels.shot: medium shot at a low desk, stacks of palm leaves
panels.action: Late at night, Jyeshthadeva sits alone, palm leaves spread out—Sanskrit texts on one side, blank leaves on the other—while the flickering lamp casts shifting shadows over geometric sketches.

dialogue.text: So he makes a decision. The proofs he carries in his mind will be laid bare, step by step, in Malayalam—the language of his students’ thoughts.

i18n.hi: तो वह ठान लेता है। दिमाग में सँजोए सिद्धांत अब खुल कर आएँगे, कदम दर कदम, मलयालम में—छात्रों की सोच की भाषा में.

panels.shot: slow push‑in from medium to closer shot
panels.action: He inscribes the opening lines on a fresh palm leaf, writing the title in neat script, then beginning with calm, ordered sentences rather than compact verse.

dialogue.text: He calls it Yuktibhāṣā—‘discourse of reasoning’—a Malayalam prose companion to earlier Sanskrit works, rich with explanations and proofs.

i18n.hi: वह इसे युक्तिभाषा नाम देता है—‘तर्क की वाणी’—पहले के संस्कृत ग्रंथों का मलयालम गद्य साथी, व्याख्या और सिद्धांतों से भरपूर.

panels.shot: wide shot showing different sections piled and labeled
panels.action: Multiple bundles of palm leaves are neatly tied and arranged, some marked with small inscribed headings; nearby, Jyeshthadeva draws a circle and triangle on a wooden board, testing a geometric argument.

dialogue.text: He structures the work carefully—sections on arithmetic and geometry, on the sphere of heaven, on eclipses and planetary motion, and on subtle series expansions drawn from Madhava’s school.

i18n.hi: वह ग्रंथ को सलीके से सजाता है—अंकगणित और ज्यामिति, नभमंडल, ग्रहण और ग्रहों की गति, और माधव की परंपरा से निकली सूक्ष्म श्रेणी विस्तारों पर अलग भाग.

panels.shot: medium shot, focus on hand writing flowing Malayalam
panels.action: His hand moves steadily, carving flowing Malayalam script; beside the leaf lies a diagram of a circle, with an inscribed polygon, as if each written sentence tracks the picture.

dialogue.text: Instead of bare rules, he writes: first the setup, then the reasoning, then the conclusion—letting the reader see the climb, not only the summit.

i18n.hi: सूखे नियमों की जगह वह लिखता है: पहले स्थिति, फिर तर्क, फिर निष्कर्ष—ताकि पाठक चढ़ाई देख सके, सिर्फ़ शिखर नहीं.

panels.shot: close-up on leaf showing a small geometric figure near text
panels.action: The camera lingers on a single palm leaf: Malayalam text surrounds a simple geometric figure; the strokes are dark and firm, evidence of careful planning rather than hurried note‑taking.

dialogue.text: Where Sanskrit verses hint, he elaborates: how a chord relates to an arc, how successive corrections refine an eclipse, how infinite series can be tamed to give precise values.

i18n.hi: जहाँ संस्कृत श्लोक इशारा भर करते हैं, वह खोलकर दिखाता है: कैसे जीवा चाप से जुड़ती है, कैसे लगातार सुधार ग्रहण को निखारते हैं, कैसे अनंत श्रेणियाँ काबू में आकर सही मान देती हैं.

panels.shot: medium shot, Jyeshthadeva outdoors observing sky
panels.action: Under a clear night sky pierced by stars, Jyeshthadeva stands on a courtyard, holding a simple gnomon and sighting along it, the moon’s glow soft on his face.

dialogue.text: The text is not mere speculation—it arises from patient observation of the heavens and careful matching of calculation with the sky’s quiet motions.

i18n.hi: यह ग्रंथ कल्पना भर नहीं—धैर्य से किए आकाश के निरीक्षण और गणना को नभ की शांत चाल से मिलाने से जन्मा है.

panels.shot: medium interior shot, students crowded around him reading
panels.action: Back indoors, a group of advanced students sit around Jyeshthadeva, each holding a palm‑leaf copy, lips moving silently as they read Malayalam sentences rather than chanting Sanskrit.

dialogue.speaker: jyeshthadeva
dialogue.text: Read slowly. Let each step settle in your mind before you pass to the next.

i18n.hi: धीरे पढ़ो। हर कदम को मन में बैठने दो, फिर अगले पर बढ़ो.

panels.shot: close-up on a young student’s face lighting up
panels.action: A student’s eyes widen with sudden understanding; his hand lightly taps a diagram on his leaf, tracing the connection that the text has just revealed.

dialogue.text: For some, the effect is immediate—what was once opaque verse becomes a chain of reasons they can follow and question.

i18n.hi: कुछ के लिए असर तत्काल होता है—धुँधले श्लोक अब कारणों की कड़ी बन जाते हैं, जिसे वे पकड़ भी सकते हैं और परख भी.

panels.shot: medium shot, older Jyeshthadeva seated, students respectfully around
panels.action: Now visibly older, with greying hair and a calmer gaze, Jyeshthadeva sits as his students, including a serious young scholar, listen; a sense of decades of teaching fills the room.

dialogue.text: By the 1590s, Acyuta Pisharati’s Uparāgakriyākrama remembers him as an aged teacher, a sign that his work and guidance have shaped a generation.

i18n.hi: १५९० के दशक में अच्युत पिशारति की उपरागक्रिया क्रम उन्हें वृद्ध आचार्य के रूप में याद करती है, इशारा कि उनकी मेहनत और मार्गदर्शन ने एक पीढ़ी गढ़ी है.

panels.shot: bird’s‑eye interior shot showing manuscripts stored on shelves
panels.action: Bundles of Yuktibhāṣā palm leaves lie carefully wrapped and shelved in a traditional Kerala house, dust motes drifting in the beams of light, hinting at years of quiet preservation.

dialogue.text: No colophon tells us the exact year of composition. But the text survives in manuscripts, its Malayalam prose carrying proofs from the sixteenth century into later times.

i18n.hi: कोई कोलophon हमें रचना का ठीक वर्ष नहीं बताता। पर ग्रंथ पांडुलिपियों में बचा है, उसकी मलयालम गद्य भाषा सोलहवीं सदी की सिद्धियों को आगे के समय तक ढोती है.

panels.shot: medium shot, modern scholars imagined in soft overlay around the manuscript
panels.action: In a subtle temporal montage, the old palm‑leaf of Yuktibhāṣā rests on a table; faint, respectful silhouettes of modern scholars lean in, taking notes and gently turning the leaves.

dialogue.text: Centuries later, historians and translators study Yuktibhāṣā as one of the earliest known extended mathematical proof‑texts in an Indian vernacular.

i18n.hi: सदियों बाद, इतिहासकार और अनुवादक युक्तिभाषा को भारतीय बोलचाल भाषा में लिखे आरंभिक विस्तृत गणितीय सिद्धांत–ग्रंथों में से एक के रूप में पढ़ते हैं.

panels.shot: final wide shot back under the Kerala palms at dusk
panels.action: The scene returns to the grove near Tirur at dusk; Jyeshthadeva, now an elder, sits peacefully with his manuscripts beside him, as the sky deepens and a student walks away carrying a copy.

dialogue.text: By giving proofs in the tongue of everyday thought, Jyeshthadeva shows that knowledge travels farther when its reasoning is made speakable and shared.

i18n.hi: तर्क को रोज़मर्रा की ज़बान में रखकर ज्येष्ठदेव दिखाते हैं कि ज्ञान दूर तक जाता है, जब उसकी वजह बोलकर बाँटी जा सके.

title_i18n.hi: ज्येष्ठदेव मलयालम में सिद्धियाँ लिखते हैं

subtitle_i18n.en: In the coconut groves of Kerala, reasoning finds its own tongue
subtitle_i18n.hi: केरल के नारियल बागानों में तर्क अपनी ही ज़बान पा लेता है
